list.name: engine_type
list.label: Engine
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "telemetry", tag: "engine_type", predicate: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}", start: -30d)

list.name: engine_model
list.label: Engine model
list.query:
import "array"
named = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "engine" and r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.engine_model or exists r.engine_type)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if exists r.engine_model then r.engine_model else r.engine_type}))
  |> group()
none = array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, _value: "not reported"}])
union(tables: [named, none])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

list.name: vessel_class
list.label: Vessel class
list.query:
import "array"
named = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vessel" and r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "class_name" and exists r.vessel_class)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.vessel_class}))
  |> group()
none = array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, _value: "Swiftships USV"}])
union(tables: [named, none])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

import "strings"
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "engine" and (r._field == "lamp_red" or r._field == "lamp_mil" or r._field == "lamp_amber" or r._field == "lamp_protect"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> last()
  |> drop(fn: (column) => column =~ /^(_start|_stop|_measurement|vessel|host|instance|source|engine_type|engine_model)$/)
  |> group()
  |> set(key: "row", value: "lamps")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["row"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      on = (if exists r.lamp_red and r.lamp_red == 1.0 then "RED STOP " else "")
         + (if exists r.lamp_mil and r.lamp_mil == 1.0 then "MIL " else "")
         + (if exists r.lamp_amber and r.lamp_amber == 1.0 then "AMBER " else "")
         + (if exists r.lamp_protect and r.lamp_protect == 1.0 then "PROTECT " else "")
      return {_value: if on == "" then "OFF" else strings.trimSpace(v: on)}
  })
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
